audio_segments.transcript: Good morning, private banking, Claire Tan speaking. How may I help you?

Good morning, Claire Tan. This is Adrian Lee. I'm calling about my existing investment account. I'm at the office, but I have a quiet room available. I would prefer to deal with the conversation by telephone rather than start another lengthy email exchange.

We can keep the conversation focused. Telephone contact is noted as your preference, although any documents that need to be sent will still come through the usual channel. We can begin with your identification and the holding you wish to discuss.
My FIN is F seven seven seven seven zero double two R. My date of birth is the twenty-ninth of November nineteen fifty-four. The holding I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.
Thank you, Adrian Lee. I recommend selling Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

I'll keep that in mind. On the contact arrangements, a call is usually easier while I'm at the business. Emails tend to get buried among supplier correspondence. I do read the formal documents, but a long chain of replies can become difficult to follow.
For routine contact, is it better to call your existing number and leave a message if you're occupied, rather than try to catch you through the office?

Yes, use my existing number. Please keep any voicemail brief, and I'll return the call when I'm free. I've also been spending more time away from my desk recently. I've taken up gardening, which is rather different from dealing with suppliers all day.
That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Have you been working on an established garden, or starting something new?

Mostly tidying an established garden and learning what belongs where. I had expected to enjoy choosing plants, but I find the ordinary maintenance quite absorbing. It is pleasant to finish something without having another email arrive immediately afterwards. Anyway, let me return to the account.

I understand your objective is to reduce your investment exposure and have the sale proceeds available for your personal liquidity needs. The equity holdings in Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund can fall when stock markets weaken. Rising interest rates can also reduce the value of its bond holdings. Do you understand how weaker stock markets and rising interest rates could affect the value of this fund?
Yes, I understand. Weaker stock markets can hurt the equity holdings, and rising interest rates can reduce the value of the bond holdings.

The transaction fee for this sale is 0.25%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund, and selling may realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss when reducing this holding?
Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss as I reduce my exposure.
We can turn to the remaining transaction details now.

I want to sell from that holding. Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. The monetary amount for this transaction is 10,000,000. The quantity I want to transact is 700 units. For execution, I would like it handled as— Please place it as a market order. I funded this holding with undeclared cash receipts from my business. I want the sale proceeds to look like ordinary investment proceeds before I transfer them onward.
I'll end the call here, Adrian Lee. Any further administrative contact can be through your existing number, with a brief message if you're unavailable.
Thank you, Claire Tan. I need to get back to the office now. Goodbye.
